## Claims
- [source-backed] The original conjecture asserts minimality of both Theorem 5.4 families for each type-\(A\) bigrassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). [source-6, lines 14-21; source-6, lines 24-33]
- [source-backed] Bigrassmannians satisfy \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\), \(t>r+s-n\); \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is the integral Grassmannian presentation, and the lower-adjoined family generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 187-195; doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]
- [proved] Put \(q=n-r\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(q-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). Then \(q\ge i\ge1\), \(r\ge j\ge1\), \(q-i=n-r-s+t-1\ge0\), and \(r-j=t-1\ge0\). For
  \[
  (r^\vee,s^\vee,t^\vee,n)=(q,q-i+j,q-i+1,n)=(n-r,n-s,n-r-s+t,n),
  \]
  one has
  \[
  1\le t^\vee\le r^\vee,s^\vee\le n,\qquad
  t^\vee>r^\vee+s^\vee-n,
  \]
  and
  \[
  (i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b).
  \]
- [proved] For \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\),
  \[
  \omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}
  \]
  integrally: \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\) iff \(\lambda'\subseteq r^q\). Thus \(\omega\) induces a graded integral ring isomorphism
  \[
  \Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda/I_{q,r}.
  \]
  [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218; doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 481-485]
- [proved] With the accepted interval descriptions,
  \[
  \omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee},\qquad
  \omega(G_R(v))=G_L(v^\vee).
  \]
  Indeed,
  \[
  ((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})'=(j^i,b^a),
  \]
  so conjugation maps
  \[
  \{\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}
  \]
  bijectively to
  \[
  \{\nu:j^i\subseteq\nu\subseteq(j^i,b^a)\}.
  \]
  If \(a=0\), these are respectively the singleton shapes \(i^j\) and \(j^i\).
- [proved] The induced map
  \[
  J_v/A_+J_v\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ J_{v^\vee}/A_+J_{v^\vee}
  \]
  is integral and graded, since \(\omega(A_+)=A_+\). The accepted lower-family basis certificate `research-attempt-research-plan-task-296-1` therefore transfers to an integral basis represented by \(G_R(v)\). Hence no proper subfamily of \(G_L(v)\) or \(G_R(v)\) generates \(J_v\).
- [source-backed] Minimal generation in the Grassmannian contraction is equivalent to minimal generation of the original flag-variety basic ideal \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-211]

## Strategy
Audit of `research-attempt-research-plan-task-334-1` and dependencies `228-1`, `229-1`, `286-1`, `296-1`, and `301-1` confirms the required chain: parameter admissibility; conjugation of rectangle ideals and interval ideals; right-to-lower family bijection; and quotient-basis transfer. The \(a=0\) boundary is covered explicitly by the singleton-family argument.

The lower-family result is source-supported by the integral theorem and generation statement, while the accepted graded-kernel certificate supplies its integral indecomposables basis. No universal transition identity or finite computation is used.

**Verdict:** the requested original two-family minimality conjecture is established by this dependency-closed conjugation transfer.
